sections.text:
# Statement Export Requirements
The system must allow account owners to export statements as CSV.
Only the account owner may view statement exports.
Acceptance: export generation must finish within 30 seconds for up to 1,000 transactions.
Unknown: Should delegated finance officers be allowed to export statements?
Business rule: statement exports cannot include transactions from another account.
